Detex lists the paa files used in the special bis file 
TexHeaders.bin

 
as such it is not needed on the command line if in the 
same dir as detex

 
Output analysis is to screen

 
<br>
Syntax:<br> <br>
DeTex [-p] [TexHeaders[.bin]]<br>

 
-p Dont pause<br> <br> <br> <br>
